description: This file defines the MicrosoftAccountOptionsConfiguration class, which implements configuration interfaces for setting up Microsoft Account authentication options within an ASP.NET Core application. It manages configuration settings, including client ID, secret, callback path, and token saving, with dependency injection of settings, data protection, and logging services.

classes.name: MicrosoftAccountOptionsConfiguration
